description: Return bounded, page-cited source excerpts or the document's existing summary (reading_mode="summary"). reading_mode="sequential" reads in page order where the client allows it; in Claude it returns the summary. Unmatched material is never presented as verified evidence. 返回有界摘录或现成摘要；不能把无匹配的资料当作已验证证据。

cursor.description: next_cursor returned by the previous sequential call; pass it back unchanged
cursor.title: Cursor

max_passages.description: Maximum number of page-cited passages to return (1-6)
max_passages.title: Max Passages

query.description: Claim or fact to locate in the source; optional in sequential reading mode
query.title: Query

reading_mode.description: relevant: passages matching query; summary: the document's existing summary; sequential: page-order reading where the client allows it (Claude receives the summary instead)
reading_mode.title: Reading Mode

source_id.description: Source identifier returned by a search tool
source_id.title: Source Id

source_type.description: Source type returned by a search tool
source_type.title: Source Type

start_page.description: Optional first page when starting a new sequential reading
start_page.title: Start Page

name: get_evidence
